text: Your shower's the only ten minutes you get to yourself. Make it smell like Vicks. This is VapoShower Plus: eucalyptus and essential oils, plus menthol and camphor scents. Ten percent more of that blend than the original. One tablet on the shower floor, right in the stream. The steam carries it through the whole bathroom. It's non-medicated, so it's for the scent, not a cold remedy. Twelve tablets, twelve steamy showers. Grab one for you and one to gift. It's in the orange cart.
